title: Episode 04A/04B — Remaining Five Women · Chotu workshop
scope: Only the five remaining leads Shivani, Taniya, Soniya, Meenakshi and Shreya. Ankita is now in the dedicated EP04A scene plan and separate EP04B archive.
sourcePolicy: Latest author-approved scene beats remain intact. These are proposed future encounters with exact staging for review, not claims of published prose. Previously missing or contested events remain unresolved until approval. Ankita tracks were moved unchanged to episode-04b-ankita-chotu-archive.json; do not duplicate them in this workshop.
invariants: All involved are adults; ages/identities follow existing source; station tea vendor name still provisional.
A precedes B per track; B cannot be an automatic replay of A. Physical staging must be legible and voluntary actions explicitly chosen.
No minors, coercion, hidden recording, forced touching, nudity, generic affair, or unearned relationship declarations.
Different event mechanisms, vantage points, reactions and outcomes for each track; no mechanical repeated bending scenes.
Twins are timeline/context references only; their established scenes are not displaced or duplicated.
Existing Jan2 events (Meenakshi M08 senior review 11:00–11:40, Taniya 10:30–19:30 office shift, etc.) remain in force; old speculative plans need later full collision review.

leads.name: Shivani
leads.endJan01: EP03 society scene ends 17:57. Saved deferred Kavya/Deepu/Karan/Aman night plan occupies 19:05–19:23.
leads.twins: Karan–Aman are society acquaintances; Harsh–Laksh are college adult student twins. They remain off-stage in Chotu-only scenes.

tracks.twinsContext: EP04A Sh Scene04 at 19:11–19:23; follow Taniya twins event ~20:16–20:24. Day1 Chotu accident occurs BEFORE both sister and twins, not 19:26.

a.title: The backdrop accident — first private society Chotu contact
a.cause: One of the backdrop's latches releases before the roll is secure. Deepu holds the padded panel upright while Shivani steps back from its path, catches the edge of his shirt for balance and unexpectedly ends up very close, front-to-front. He steadies her at the clothed upper back; both stop immediately when the panel is stable. It is a genuine accident, not a planned groping.
a.physical: Brief front-to-front clothed contact, one hand on his shirt, one steadying hand at upper back; approximately 2–3 seconds.
a.sightline: The quiet service alcove has no spectators; the doorway remains visible. No wardrobe tear, nudity, or fabricated exposure.
a.duration: Front-to-front closeness ~2–3 seconds while padded backdrop is stabilized; full scene 18:51–19:05.
a.reaction: Shivani, usually in control of teasing, loses her next sentence for an instant and feels a quick thrill. Deepu is startled and apologizes, first checking her safety.
a.hook: Kavya joins at 19:05; twins at 19:11; the January 2 society rehearsal is separate.

b.title: A deliberate partner mark
b.choice: For the cultural rehearsal, Shivani voluntarily chooses Deepu to check a two-person blocking mark instead of doing it alone; she asks first and he accepts.
b.physical: They clasp palms and take two small coordinated steps into the correct light mark, briefly holding their joined hands until she gives the release cue.
b.test: Can he meet her playful intensity without copying Karan's noisy teasing or Aman's reserve?
b.result: Deepu answers with an unexpectedly clear, self-assured line and lets her end the hold. Shivani feels an unmistakable rush from choosing the contact, then laughs at being momentarily wrong-footed.
b.after: The event proof is completed; no forced intimacy or Kavya's independent reaction claimed.

tracks.twinsContext: Harsh/Laksh are established adult college twins and remain in their own classes; this is a Sunny-only staff AV scene. Ayaan/Armaan's twin status is not assumed.

a.title: The feedback shock
a.cause: During a small staff-only mic check, a sudden speaker feedback burst makes Shivani and Sunny reach for the same mixing-board mute control.
a.physical: Their wrists cross at the mixer; Shivani's shoulder briefly brushes his as both step behind the desk to shut the sound off.
a.sightline: Staff-only AV booth, chest-up framing and visible joined hands. No undressing or imagined students witnessing an accident.
a.duration: Crossed wrists and shoulder brush ~2 seconds.
a.reaction: The jolt starts as surprise at the sound, then she is annoyed to notice the resulting breathless pause in his company. Sunny is focused on fixing gain levels.
a.hook: A second run-through is genuinely required before the staff presentation.

b.title: The quiet rehearsal
b.choice: Shivani asks Sunny to demonstrate the narrow backstage movement for the cue sheet, offering her hand so he can guide a safe two-step pass; he explicitly agrees.
b.physical: Hand-in-hand for the short rehearsal, a measured close pass, then separated when the cue light switches on.
b.test: Will Sunny hold the charged moment or keep his strictly assistant-like composure?
b.result: Sunny carefully steps back and says the cue is ready. Shivani feels excited by the choice, but his reserve refuses to give her an easy reading; that unresolved result differs from Deepu's confident response.
b.after: No invented student/faculty relationship or extra intimacy.

leads.name: Taniya
leads.endJan01: EP03 office shift closes 19:30; Guddu quotation 20:08–20:15, twins lobby 20:16–20:24, Soniya/Rahul home to approx. 21:00.
leads.twins: Karan–Aman Jan1 lobby incident preserved, not duplicated. Raghav–Chirag are not biological twins.

tracks.twinsContext: Raghav/Chirag are work duo, not twins. Karan/Aman's Jan1 lobby contact remains separate; neither appears at the firm.

a.title: The collapsing file tray
a.cause: Punit opens the misaligned bottom filing tray as Taniya retrieves a reconciliation binder; the overloaded tray slips forward.
a.physical: Both catch the binder together. Her hand closes over his fingers beneath its spine while his other forearm steadies the tray; their shoulders bump before they regain footing.
a.sightline: Closed records aisle; hands, binder and brief shoulder collision visible, not a wardrobe incident. Nobody sees the split-second contact.
a.reaction: Taniya initially scolds the cabinet, then recognizes the tremor in her own voice when Punit apologizes. He laughs with unexpected composure.
a.hook: His corrected client totals are due before 19:30 shift end.

b.title: The unplanned celebration she chooses
b.choice: The reconciliation clears. Rather than giving a routine managerial nod, Taniya asks Punit for a spontaneous two-step victory turn in an empty meeting corner; he says yes.
b.physical: She takes both his hands and initiates a single light turn, then they separate with a startled laugh.
b.test: Will her usually serious junior freeze, or answer her unexpected physical playfulness?
b.result: Punit confidently completes the step and jokes that she underestimates him. Taniya enjoys the surprise and feels an electric little thrill at having initiated something so unlike her desk persona.
b.after: Work continues until 19:30; no new romantic claim.

tracks.twinsContext: Jan1 Guddu quotation handover at 20:08–20:15 and later Karan/Aman lobby brush remain unchanged. The new physical setup belongs to Jan2 only.

a.title: The sliding sample frame
a.cause: Guddu has the missing wedding-quotation page and a compact venue-fabric sample on a wheeled frame. A latch slips while Taniya checks the invoice.
a.physical: Taniya catches the rolling bar; Guddu braces the other end. Their clothed shoulders touch as they stop the frame before it tips.
a.sightline: Service sample bay; others have already cleared the counter, but no claim of secluded romance. Focus on the moving frame, shoulders and joined grip.
a.reaction: Taniya remembers Guddu's Jan1 teasing and finds his decisive action unexpectedly attractive; he is amused by her immediate joke about quality control.
a.hook: The secured frame is needed for a true side-by-side height check minutes later.

b.title: The bride's deliberately chosen measurement
b.choice: Taniya asks Guddu to hold the sample backdrop while she stands beside him and checks how its edge frames two adult silhouettes. She steps into the marked area willingly.
b.physical: Her hand rests briefly on his clothed shoulder to position the banner; he holds the frame still, then both step clear when the measurement is done.
b.test: Instead of waiting for a compliment, Taniya asks whether the placement makes her look more like a client or a bride.
b.result: Guddu replies with cheerful, direct honesty rather than Punit's surprised composure. She feels a warm, self-conscious charge but walks home in control of the moment.
b.after: No claim that the wedding or fiancé Aditya's status has changed.

leads.name: Soniya

tracks.twinsContext: Karan/Aman's earlier society-gym familiarity is only background. They do not appear here and the trainer Vivek Rao is not mislabeled Chotu.

a.title: The runaway equipment trolley
a.cause: Guddu delivers a low trolley of folded community yoga mats. A wheel catches the court threshold just as Soniya moves aside for it.
a.physical: Soniya grips Guddu's forearm while both control the tipping trolley; they end shoulder-to-shoulder for a breath before stepping apart.
a.sightline: Covered society court, not a changing room; bodies fully dressed, emphasis on arm support, moving equipment and their immediate reactions.
a.reaction: Unlike inexperienced Dhika, Soniya recognizes her own quick interest immediately; Guddu is trying to prevent the mats spilling and does not make an assumption.
a.hook: Court measurement and layout correction are still due before the event crew leaves.

b.title: The willing layout demonstration
b.choice: Soniya volunteers to demonstrate the court's two-person spacing, asking Guddu to act as her partner with a clear chance to decline. He agrees.
b.physical: She takes his forearm to check the spacing, then briefly interlocks hands for a counted step across the painted line before releasing them.
b.test: Does Guddu turn the proximity into flirtation, or show composure even after the earlier startled contact?
b.result: He meets her gaze, smiles, then returns to precise measurements. Soniya is surprised that the mixture of mutual awareness and restraint gives her a fresh rush.
b.after: Her previous Vivek Rao gym experience and Rahul conversation remain separate; no implied new affair.

a.title: The stuck car hatch
a.cause: Following Babloo's Jan1 offer to help recover the car, Meenakshi checks the luggage hatch while Babloo steadies its faulty latch; the hatch begins closing unexpectedly.
a.physical: She grips his upper arm to move safely aside while he supports the hatch. Their coats/shoulders press briefly before the hatch is held open.
a.sightline: Open society parking bay; no private wardrobe display. Only the two participants are within the hatch working zone.
a.reaction: Meenakshi is startled by how quickly she reached for him rather than by any lingering glance. Babloo focuses on the mechanical problem, then gives a bold, light reply.
a.hook: Babloo helps finish the car-recovery handoff; Meenakshi makes her hospital duty before 09:10.

b.title: A gratitude hug she starts
b.choice: After confirming the recovered car is safe, Meenakshi deliberately steps forward and asks, 'Ek proper thank-you hug chalega?' Babloo agrees.
b.physical: One brief full, clothed embrace; she initiates it and steps back first, leaving both surprised by its warmth.
b.test: Does the usually teasing Babloo return the embrace confidently or freeze?
b.result: He freezes for a heartbeat, then returns it gently. Meenakshi feels a swift physical thrill because she chose the unusually personal thanks; he is momentarily speechless for the first time.
b.after: No invented repair bill, missing hospital time or expectation of further intimacy.

tracks.setting: Hospital · administrative copy / training annexure space
tracks.twinsContext: Avi and Yash are a hospital work duo, NOT twins. Uday/Utkarsh are society twins; neither group is present in this Naveen scene.

a.title: The loose annexure binder
a.cause: After the locked 11:00–11:40 senior review, Naveen returns with the missing annexure in a wide binder. Its clip springs as Meenakshi opens it.
a.physical: They reach together to catch the falling pages; their forearms cross and their shoulders briefly touch in the narrow copy room.
a.sightline: Staff-only administrative space, not a patient room or locker. No clinical exposure; visible hands, pages and momentary closeness.
a.reaction: She makes a quick joke, but his attentive composure lingers with her after he leaves. Naveen feels relieved his mistake did not cost trust.
a.hook: The follow-up wellness-camp first-aid orientation provides a plausible afternoon return.

b.title: The voluntary first-aid demonstration
b.choice: For volunteer orientation, Meenakshi asks Naveen to give his hand for a demonstration of safe wrist support and bandaging; he agrees.
b.physical: She intentionally steadies his wrist with one palm and guides the bandage with the other, staying close only for the short practical demonstration.
b.test: Can a normally shy administrator respond to sustained attention without copying Babloo's spontaneous boldness?
b.result: Naveen quietly but confidently repeats the technique and returns her direct gaze. Meenakshi notices her own involuntary shiver while keeping the lesson professional.
b.after: Concludes before older 14:35 team travel proposal. Jan1 14:15 Naveen cutpoint remains a separate unfinished source, not retroactively rewritten.

leads.name: Shreya
leads.endJan01: EP03 reaches society Chintu register at 17:35–17:45 after Samar–Shaan sports. Station Chotu earlier has an approved strong-chai introduction.
leads.twins: Samar–Shaan are a society duo, twin status unconfirmed; Karan–Aman cross on Jan1 college duty, not inserted into Chotu scenes.

tracks.twinsContext: Karan/Aman Jan1 college and Samar/Shaan society sports threads are elsewhere; none is a spectator at the tea counter. Station Chotu is not Chintu.

a.title: The tipping kettle
a.cause: At the familiar strong-chai counter, a kettle handle slips while Chotu shifts the kettle. Shreya moves her file away from the splash.
a.physical: He briefly guides her wrist clear of the hot spill and immediately releases it; her uniform cuff is spotted with tea, not displaced.
a.sightline: Authorized staff-counter alcove; hot-surface safety, wrist and uniform cuff visible. No bare-body exposure or public humiliation.
a.reaction: Shreya, used to being the one in control, is jolted by the reflexive protective contact. Chotu checks for burns rather than playing it for a compliment.
a.hook: His hand has a minor, non-graphic steam irritation; the next counter duty check brings them together later.

b.title: She chooses to steady his hand
b.choice: Shreya voluntarily returns during a short duty break with basic first-aid dressing and asks Chotu whether she may look at his mildly irritated hand. He agrees.
b.physical: She holds his hand steady while applying a small clean bandage, then releases it after asking whether it feels comfortable.
b.test: Will the confident strong-chai joker keep teasing, or answer her unexpected care sincerely?
b.result: He goes quiet and thanks her without a joke. Her reaction is a brief electric shiver at the unexpected sincerity, different from his earlier teasing confidence.
b.after: She returns to policing; no coercive police-power or promised romance.

tracks.setting: Gulmohar Heights · security gate / visitor desk
tracks.twinsContext: Samar/Shaan society fitness scene ends Jan1 17:33; Chintu's existing Jan1 register conversation is 17:35–17:45. The new accident is Jan2, not inserted into that frozen slot.

a.title: The swinging service gate
a.cause: A service cart crosses the driveway; a gust pushes the light swing gate across the desk approach as Shreya checks a visitor-register note.
a.physical: Shreya grips Chintu's upper sleeve and steps close as he catches the gate, then immediately lets go when the cart passes.
a.sightline: Gate-side interaction, brief contact over uniform/sleeve; no private visibility or hidden spectators.
a.duration: Sleeve hold and close step ~2 seconds.
a.reaction: Shreya feels a fast adrenaline jolt, while Chintu keeps his attention on the cart and her safe exit. Their previous dry-wit rapport is retained.
a.hook: He has one disputed visitor time that she asks to check only against recorded evidence by evening.

b.title: A purposeful shared register check
b.choice: On returning to society Shreya deliberately stands beside Chintu at the register and asks permission to guide his pen over the discrepant number she wants rechecked.
b.physical: Her hand briefly covers his pen hand to trace the line, then releases; shoulder-to-shoulder while both read the record.
b.test: Will he respond to the unusual closeness or remain entirely absorbed in doing the register correctly?
b.result: Chintu accurately corrects the procedure and misses the personal implication altogether. Shreya is amused—and faintly unsettled—by her own reaction to a moment he treated as pure work.
b.after: No fabricated evidence, coercive scrutiny or new attraction attributed to Chintu.
